content.text:
No security-relevant changes. The diff:
1. Moves `currentSeason` (pure date-math helper) from a local function to a shared module — no behavior change.
2. Threads `candidateArgs.season` (a server-computed string derived from `new Date().getMonth()`, returning one of four literals: "Winter"/"Spring"/"Summer"/"Autumn") into `rankTopN` as a ranking preference.

The `season` value is not user-influenceable and is not consumed by any sink — it is used only for in-memory scoring inside `rankTopN`/`seasonFit`. No entry-point, authorization, or sink surface is touched. The surrounding handler continues to enforce the same auth/quota checks (`supabase.auth.getUser()`, `assertCanGenerate`).
